model.title: Veo3.1 Lite Text to Video
model.shortDescription: Veo 3.1 Lite balances practical utility with professional capabilities, supporting Text-to-Video and Image-to-Video
model.pricingInfoOverride: For every second of video you generate you will be charged **$0.05** for 720p with audio, **$0.03** for 720p without audio, **$0.08** for 1080p with audio or **$0.05** for 1080p without audio. For example, a **4 second video** at **720p with audio** will cost **$0.20**.
